trades.name: Hold of 7405-7408
trades.quote: Long a hold of 7405-7408 is probably the cleanest for direct continuation higher. As long as 17.5-19.5 reclaims then a retest of 28-31 and today’s high is in play. Runners can balloon nicely if today’s high is taken out so I rate this trade pretty highly (A/A-)

trades.name: Persistent failures at 7428-7431 (incl. LAAF)
trades.quote: I think it is reasonable to short persistent failures at 7428-7431 (including if we get a LAAF first or a LAAF of today’s high) but it would need to get firmly back below 17.5-19.5 to potentially see 7405-7408 (eyes open for a bid as high as 10-12). Monitor for continuation from there. Given broad bullish context I objectively have to rate this trade much lower than the above long but it is reasonable.
